name: Devouring Gourd
body:
DEVOURING GOURD
CR 4

A hulking, emerald-green gourd mottled with rough protrusions, its cracked rind revealing a jagged maw wide enough to swallow a horse.

XP 1,200
NE Huge plant (amphibious)
Init +3; Senses blindsight 20 ft., low-light vision; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 7, flat-footed 17 (–1 Dex, +10 natural, –2 size)
hp 45 (7d8+14)
Fort +7, Ref +3, Will +2
Immune plant traits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., burrow 10 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee bite +8 (2d6+7 plus grab)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks ensnaring fibers, horrific gorging, swallow whole (1d6 bludgeoning and 1d6 acid damage, AC 15, 4 hp)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 9, Con 14, Int 11, Wis 11, Cha 10
Base Atk +5; CMB +12 (+16 grapple); CMD 21 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Horrific Gorgingha, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack
Skills Perception +10, Stealth +0, Swim +17
Languages Common
SQ amphibious

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Ensnaring Fibers (Ex)

A devouring gourd can manipulate its innards to ensnare creatures it has swallowed. As a full-round action, a devouring gourd can attempt to use its swallow whole ability and if it succeeds in swallowing a creature, it can make a second grapple check to give the swallowed creature the pinned condition. A devouring gourd can also attempt to pin a creature it has previously swallowed as a standard action. A creature that escapes this pin can choose to end up in the devouring gourd’s mouth or remain in its stomach.

Horrific Gorging (Ex)

As a full-round action, the devouring gourd can completely consume a dead, unconscious, paralyzed, or otherwise helpless creature it could normally swallow with its swallow whole ability. This deals bite damage as a critical hit and swallows the creature using its swallow whole special ability. Allies of the swallowed creature within 30 feet that see this horrific feast must succeed at a DC 13 Will save to avoid being shaken for 1d4 rounds. This part of the ability is a mind-affecting fear effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment non-cold forests, plains, and rivers
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

Devouring gourds are large, malevolent plants that grow massive on the flesh of people and other living creatures.

There is no maximum size to such plants, but most of those encountered are between a horse and an elephant in girth, for that is when their size difference is undeniable.

Devouring gourds need sunlight like other plants, but unlike most plants, they also derive nutrients by digesting the bodies of living creatures, mostly people and animals.

Devouring gourds always wish to eat, even when they are completely sated. They have no “off switch” when it comes to food.

They particularly enjoy eating families, the cuter the better.
